fields.title: About Me
fields.description: I am an intermediate Python developer transitioning into the worlds of Data Science and Data Engineering . My journey began with mastering the fundamentals of Python—building everything from expense trackers to chatbots—and has evolved into a passion for architecting data solutions. Currently, I am expanding my expertise in web development and AI automation through my agency, FlyVark AI, while preparing for an MSc in Data Science. I thrive at the intersection of clean code and actionable data.

fields.title: Building Automated Finance Tools with Python
fields.content:
Managing finances in Nigeria can be complex with inflation and multiple income streams. That's why I decided to build Budget-Pilot, a personal expense tracker.

The Process ;

Using Python and MySQL, I developed a system that:

Tracks every Naira spent in real-time.

Categorizes expenses automatically.

Visualizes monthly spending trends.

The Lesson ;

The biggest challenge wasn't the code; it was the data structure. Moving from a beginner to an intermediate Python developer meant learning how to handle database relations efficiently
